contract: GET /api/me/series/:id/remove-from-continue-listening adds an existing series id to the caller's users.extraData.seriesHideFromContinueListening, answers 200 with the caller's browser user view, and emits user_updated to the caller only when the stored list changed; an unknown series answers 404.
exceptions: force is not applicable: this route has no force, hard or override mode

invariants.contract: Removing an existing series appends its id to the caller's stored seriesHideFromContinueListening, answers 200 with the browser user view that GET /api/me returns afterwards, moves users.updatedAt forward and emits user_updated with that view to the caller's sockets only; another user's hidden list stays untouched.
Removing an already hidden series answers 200 with the same single-entry list, does not duplicate the id, leaves users.extraData and updatedAt unchanged and emits no user_updated event.
Removing an unknown series answers 404 without changing any user's hidden list; without a valid token the route answers 401.
